title: PROVENANCE_REPLAY_SOURCE_UNIVERSE_STANDALONE_CLOSURE_HOSTILE_FEEDER

R02-H07.qualification: Transitive-reference sufficiency removes repeated direct-field copies, but it does not permit omission of interpretation-critical closure material. Every required producer object, authority snapshot, source-universe identity, query/risk-set/measure identity, negative state and role-preserving reference-contract edge must be included or exactly immutable-addressable through a packaged hash-bound resolution contract.
R02-H07.failure_rule: Missing, ambiguous, mutable, version-conflicting, hash-mismatched or label-reconstructed required dependency fails closed as integrity failure.

R02-H09.holding: ReplayReceipt is audit/replay-only and has no independent runtime-prior semantics.

R02-H06_supporting.holding: V557/V558 may physically package producer material without semantically re-owning it.

distinguished_closure_claims.FULL_OFFLINE_EMPIRICAL_REPLAY: Additionally requires exact C11 M01-M18 content material or an immutable content-addressed C11 resolver under the receipt's exact content identity. A C11 hash alone is not replay material.
